answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 15 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 860 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The ocean is the check that cannot be faked, the mirror is the price the attacker pays, and the ivory is the record that outlives the epoch.
